source: MATH test split (5,000 problems; DigitalLearningGmbH/MATH-lighteval test)
rule: drop problems without a reference \boxed answer and any problem matching a pool (MATH train) task: exact after normalisation, token-3-gram Jaccard >= 0.9, or Jaccard >= 0.8 with the same normalised answer
hash_rule: sha256 of newline-joined '<id>:<sha256(problem)>:<sha256(answer)>' over the frozen list in id order; the list itself is private
